title: Administrative unit
description: One record of data/gazetteer/units.jsonl (and the base of /api/v1/units/{pcode}.json).

level.description: 1 division, 2 district, 3 upazila or city corporation, 4 union, paurashava or ward.

name_bn.description: Bangla name; null where no open source provides one.

parent_pcode.description: Current parent. For level 4 this is the v03 upazila the unit lies in, so its pcode prefix may differ.

ancestry.description: Ancestor pcodes from division downwards, excluding the unit itself.

boundary.description: TopoJSON file (relative to data/) and object name holding this unit's shape.

parent_pcode_2015.description: Level 4 only: upazila pcode in the 2015 release (old 8-character scheme).
